among.meaning: in the middle of, or surrounded by, a group of things or people

awoke.meaning: past tense of awake: stopped sleeping

chose.meaning: past tense of choose: picked out from several options

clung.meaning: past tense of cling: held on tightly
clung.example: the child clung to her hand

could.meaning: past tense of can: was able to; also used to ask politely or suggest

crept.meaning: past tense of creep: moved slowly and quietly
crept.example: the cat crept towards the bird

dealt.meaning: past tense of deal: handed out, or handled a matter

doing.meaning: present participle of do: performing or carrying out an action

drank.meaning: past tense of drink: swallowed a liquid
drank.example: he drank a glass of water

dwelt.meaning: past tense of dwell: lived in a place

eaten.meaning: past participle of eat: consumed as food

flung.meaning: past tense of fling: threw with force

froze.meaning: past tense of freeze: turned to ice, or stopped still

hunky.meaning: informal: strong and attractive (of a man); 'hunky-dory' means fine

knelt.meaning: past tense of kneel: rested on the knees
knelt.example: he knelt to tie his shoe

leapt.meaning: past tense of leap: jumped high or far
leapt.example: the deer leapt over the fence

lived.meaning: past tense of live: was alive, or had a home somewhere
lived.example: they lived in Pune for years

meant.meaning: past tense of mean: intended, or signified

media.meaning: plural of medium: newspapers, TV, radio and the internet as a whole
media.example: the story was all over the media

ought.meaning: used to say what is the right or sensible thing to do

pouty.meaning: pushing the lips out in a sulky or playful way

radii.meaning: plural of radius: lines from the centre of a circle to its edge

recut.meaning: to cut again, especially to re-edit a film

riper.meaning: comparative of ripe: more fully grown and ready to eat
riper.example: the mangoes are riper this week

shall.meaning: used to talk about the future or to make an offer or suggestion

shalt.meaning: old form of shall, used with 'thou'

shied.meaning: past tense of shy: drew back suddenly in fear or dislike
shied.example: the horse shied at the noise

shone.meaning: past tense of shine: gave out light, or did very well

shown.meaning: past participle of show: displayed or made visible

since.meaning: from a time in the past until now; also 'because'

slept.meaning: past tense of sleep: rested with eyes closed and mind at rest

slung.meaning: past tense of sling: threw carelessly, or hung loosely
slung.example: he slung the bag over his shoulder

slunk.meaning: past tense of slink: moved away quietly, often out of shame

snuck.meaning: informal past tense of sneak: moved secretly

spied.meaning: past tense of spy: caught sight of, or watched secretly
spied.example: she spied a kite in the sky

spilt.meaning: past tense of spill: let liquid flow out by accident
spilt.example: no use crying over spilt milk

stank.meaning: past tense of stink: smelt very bad

stood.meaning: past tense of stand: was upright on the feet, or stayed in a position

stunk.meaning: past participle of stink: smelt very bad
stunk.example: the fridge has stunk for days

swore.meaning: past tense of swear: promised solemnly, or used rude words
swore.example: he swore to keep the secret

swung.meaning: past tense of swing: moved back and forth or in a curve

these.meaning: plural of this: the ones here

those.meaning: plural of that: the ones there

threw.meaning: past tense of throw: sent through the air with the hand

turbo.meaning: short for turbocharger: a device that gives an engine extra power

twixt.meaning: old or poetic form of betwixt: between
twixt.example: twixt the cup and the lip

until.meaning: up to the point in time or the event mentioned

which.meaning: asking or specifying one out of a set

would.meaning: past of will: used for imagined situations, wishes and polite requests

wrote.meaning: past tense of write: put words on paper or a screen
